name: worms-port
description: MIT Phaser base with strict third-party asset traceability and Sorcerers quarantine workflow.

scripts.build-server: rimraf server/build && parcel build server/src/server.ts -t node -d server/build --no-source-maps
scripts.build-client: rimraf client/build && parcel build client/src/index.html -d client/build --no-source-maps
scripts.build: npm run build-server && npm run build-client
scripts.check:compliance: npm run check:asset-manifest && npm run check:import-boundary
scripts.watch-server: rimraf server/dist && parcel server/src/server.ts -t node -d server/dist
scripts.watch-client: rimraf client/dist && parcel watch client/src/*.html -d client/dist

author: TasirWimp
